description: This file defines the CanvasActionTrust object responsible for validating whether a given URL is trusted within the application's context, including normalization and matching logic for trusted URLs.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasActionUrl
methods.description: Checks if a given URL is trusted based on predefined rules and normalization.

methods.name: matchesTrustedRemoteA2uiUrlExact
methods.description: Determines if a candidate URI matches a trusted URL exactly after normalization.

methods.name: normalizeTrustedRemoteA2uiUri
methods.description: Normalizes a URI to a standard form for comparison, ensuring scheme and host are consistent.

methods.name: parseUri
methods.description: Attempts to parse a raw URL string into a URI object, returning null if invalid.
